new_findings.expected_impact: frames the fix: chunk-granularity and budget levers, not admission levers
new_findings.what: Mechanism of the prefill-window collapse is identified in source: need_mamba_block_aligned_split = has_mamba_layers and mamba_cache_mode=='align' (scheduler.py:317). With block_size=784 every prefill chunk must end on a multiple of 784 unless block_size <= max_num_scheduled_tokens, so a 1024-token prompt is force-split 784+240 and each mixed step pays a prefill-sized forward pass. long_prefill_token_threshold only feeds this clip via max_prefill_tokens=min(max_num_scheduled_tokens, threshold) (scheduler.py:406-413), so any threshold >= 784 is a NO-OP at the default budget; thresholds < 784 make chunks 0 until budget >= threshold+784 (sub-block chunks are forbidden when block_size > max_prefill_tokens).
